title: NAIP data embedded with Clay v1.5 (rev2)
description: Clay v1.5 vector embeddings for the complete NAIP (National Agriculture Imagery Program) archive, covering US aerial imagery from 2010 through 2021. Each 256×256-pixel NAIP tile is represented as a 1024-dimensional class embedding generated by the Clay v1.5 geospatial foundation model from 4-band (RGB+NIR) GeoTIFF inputs. Data is stored in Parquet files mirroring the NAIP folder structure, with one geometry and one embedding array column per tile.

readme:
## README.md
This repository contains all of [NAIP on AWS](https://registry.opendata.aws/naip/) data embedded with [Clay v1.5](https://huggingface.co/made-with-clay/Clay).


Source: This data has been created by [Development Seed](https://developmentseed.org/) under contract with [Clay](https://madewithclay.org/) and comptute support by [AWS](https://aws.amazon.com/).

Contact: For feedback and questions, please file a ticket on the [model repo of Clay](https://github.com/Clay-foundation/model/issues) or email us at contact@madewithclay.org


Data Source: [NAIP on AWS `naip-analytic`](https://registry.opendata.aws/naip/): 
* Includes NAIP imagery from 2010 through 2021. 
* The data in this bucket is Original Imagery in Geotiff format 4-band (RGB + NIR)  

Model source: Embeddings generated from inference with Clay v1.5: 
* Embeddings have `1024` dimensions and correspond to the "class" embedding that is used alongside the patch embeddings at the end of the encoder. 
* Each tile is split into tiles of size 256x256, and the attention patch size inside Clay v1.5 is 8x8 px. 
* Inference run was done on November '24 on AWS using g4 and g6 EC2, for roughly 60k GPU hours, and costing around $65k. 

Embeddings License: Clay [CC-By](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/)

Format:
* Folder structure follows the same as NAIP folder structure.
* File format is parquet, with two columns: `geometry` and `embeddings`


Usage example

```python
import duckdb
path = "https://data.source.coop/clay/clay-v1-5-naip-2/az/2015/100cm/rgbir_cog/32110/m_3211002_se_12_1_20150530.parquet"
d = duckdb.read_parquet(path)
df = d.to_df()
df.head()
```
